messages.subject: Calderwood - disclosure deadline next week
messages.plaintextBody:
Tom,

Quick reminder that the disclosure list on Bracken Group v Calderwood Industries (CL-2025-000412) is due on 15 December. Catherine Rosenthal's chambers have asked for the updated chronology before then. Nothing to do with the Hale matter - just flagging as the dates are close together.

Donna
